forum.content_text:
STM32F030R8T - as on the Nucleo-F030R8

PD2 should be present:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ccc5b6a7-0880-4b15-8303-1d4201843255.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/a184aaa3-caf4-47b7-b6fc-1504f87aee04.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/302c3396-9c8c-4752-8e7e-3ac095540d27.png)

Therefore GPIODEN should be present at RCC\_AHBENR[20]:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/5ed26541-dfa1-4944-96d2-782dbf2b915a.png)

But it’s not present in the CubeIDE SFRs view:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ebb4f612-56a4-4e3a-b978-f9155458e353.png)

Thanks.

Mahmoud
scraped_replies.author: Mahmoud Ben Romdhane

scraped_replies.html:
Yes, I know the pin is supported - it’s the bit in CubeIDE’s display of AHBENR that’s missing!

 

 

IOPDEN should appear between IOPCEN and IOPFEN 

 

The full value of the AHBENR register is correct - it’s just that the decode of the IOPDEN bit is missing.
